description: This file defines the InputPostprocRetainTouch class, a post-processor for touch input events in Kivy, designed to delay 'up' events to prevent lost finger touches on certain hardware. It includes configuration parameters for retain time and distance, and processes touch events accordingly.

classes.name: InputPostprocRetainTouch
classes.description: A class that delays 'up' events of touch inputs to prevent lost touches, configurable via Kivy settings.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the post-processor, loading configuration for retain time and distance.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes a list of touch events, delaying 'end' events based on configuration to prevent lost touches.
